value.rationale: A sharp and natural invariant-reconstruction threshold for an oligomorphic homogeneous digraph: one numerical type count has infinitely many collisions with unbounded parameter-size separation, while two counts completely recover the finite-base occupancy parameters and all higher counts without knowing the cardinality of the base. This is not a mere substitution of the known parity-matrix lemma.
